Business_Definition: Logical person master identity used for registration and care access. Not a physical MDM hub in this drop.
Business_Rules: One person has one governed master identity in the cluster.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs

Business_Definition: Synthetic extract of cluster registration identity fields used to create and maintain the person record.
Business_Rules: Identity fields required before the record is treated as Active.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs
Related_Business_Terms: Patient; Patient ID; National ID; Date of Birth; Gender

Business_Definition: The cluster patient identifier (MRN) used to locate the person in operational systems.
Business_Rules: Must be unique in the governed person population; must not be blank for Active patients.

Business_Definition: The national identity number captured at registration where required.
Business_Rules: Captured where required; uniqueness material in the governed population.

Business_Definition: The recorded date of birth used to confirm identity and derive age.
Business_Rules: Must be a valid past date; not a catalogue CDE.

Business_Definition: Administrative gender recorded at registration using the approved value set.
Business_Rules: Must use the approved administrative value set.

Business_Definition: Logical encounter identity for a defined care interaction recorded in the clinical record context.
Business_Rules: An encounter is distinct from a scheduled appointment.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs

Business_Definition: Encounter-level clinical documentation context including diagnosis and documentation timestamp.
Business_Rules: Must link to a governed Patient_ID; unlabeled clinical extracts are not Public.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs
Related_Business_Terms: Encounter; Diagnosis; Encounter Date; Admission; Discharge

Business_Definition: The unique identifier of a recorded care encounter.
Business_Rules: Must be unique in the governed encounter population.

Business_Definition: The date associated with encounter documentation (Phase 7 CDE-004 timestamp context).
Business_Rules: Must not be in the future relative to the documentation calendar; timeliness is a dependent quality dimension.

Business_Definition: The date the inpatient (or equivalent) stay is recorded as started where used.
Business_Rules: Where used must not be later than Discharge_Date. Not a catalogue CDE.

Business_Definition: The date the inpatient (or equivalent) stay is recorded as ended where used.
Business_Rules: Where used must not be earlier than Admission_Date. Not a catalogue CDE.

Business_Definition: A recorded clinical diagnosis code in the medical record context.
Business_Rules: Must exist on the approved diagnosis reference list used for validity.

Business_Definition: Claim identifiers and billed service context prepared or submitted for reimbursement. Patient-linked claims are treated as Restricted under Phase 5 typical guidance.
Business_Rules: A claim should trace to a governed encounter where charge capture applies.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs

Business_Definition: The unique identifier of a claim record in the governed claims population.
Business_Rules: Must be unique in the governed claims population.

Business_Definition: A billed service / charge code used in the revenue cycle.
Business_Rules: Should be consistent with the clinical coding context of the related encounter where both exist.

Business_Definition: Practitioner identity used for care delivery and credentialing distinct from the HR employee record.
Business_Rules: Provider master is not the HR employee record.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs

Business_Definition: The unique identifier of the practitioner in the credentialing master.
Business_Rules: Must be unique in the governed provider population; consistency with HR staff identity is a cross-domain watch theme not a second Owner.

Business_Definition: Organizational location in the cluster reference structure. Single source of truth is a principle; Phase 10 architecture is not built.
Business_Data_Steward: Enterprise Data / PMO Analyst within DMO
Business_Rules: DMO hosts the Steward; DMO is not the Data Owner.
Data_Quality_Status: CDE — quality rules designed (Phase 7) for contained CDEs

Business_Definition: The reference code that identifies a facility or department in organizational master data.
Business_Data_Steward: Enterprise Data / PMO Analyst within DMO
Business_Rules: Must be unique as a reference code in the governed org list.
